text.card: A red giant 3,006 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 0.86 solar masses and 11.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,590 K at its surface.
